# Multi-Agent Knowledge Graph Enrichment Framework

This project implements a modular multi-agent system for knowledge graph construction using LLM-backed agents.

## Project Type
Python project using OpenAI SDK for multi-agent knowledge graph enrichment.

## Architecture
- Modular agent-based system
- LLM-powered extraction and reasoning
- Configurable relation schemas
- Conflict detection and resolution
- Schema alignment and verification

## Development Guidelines
- Python 3.11+
- Type hints and docstrings required
- Clean, explicit code preferred
- Environment-based configuration
